part_name: AM59 Sealed Thermoelectric Enclosure V3 - Welded Pressure Body
assumptions: The exact supplied AM59 STEP is placed with its mounting plane at Z=52 mm, fan inlet toward -X, and RF output toward +X.
Four exact supplied Seifert 3050303 STEP references are recessed into the two long walls at X=-245 and -40 mm, two per side.
The main shell is 495 x 410 x 320 mm. The cooler coamings produce a 426 mm Y envelope, while the localized 430 x 340 mm welded service collar governs the accepted pressure-body Y/Z envelope.
The normal operating configuration has an IP66/IP6X/IPX6 target only. The unpowered IPX7 target applies only when both secondary cooler-bank immersion caps and all connector caps are installed.
The four-cooler thermal selection is based on approximately 91 W per unit at 45 C ambient and 55 C cabinet air, digitized from the supplied performance curve.

The 300 W dry-boundary heat basis is 200 W AM59 severe-condition heat plus one combined 100 W allocation for auxiliaries, residual solar ingress, and estimation uncertainty; the 15 percent cooler selection margin is applied once after that sum.
A max_interference allowance of 0.5 mm3 tolerates coincident contact faces and CAD-kernel noise, not physical component overlap.
unresolved: The supplied cooler STEP/drawing envelope must be reconciled with the purchased serial-number-controlled Seifert dimensions and cutting template.
The AM59 case-to-air rise must prove a 65 C maximum case temperature at the 300 W enclosure heat basis; otherwise four coolers are insufficient.
Production baffles must establish stable fan operating points and pass correlated thermal/pressure/flow limits; the AM59 63 m3/h free-air sum is not an installed-flow requirement.
Final cooler mounting lands, lid, cap flanges, gasket glands, fasteners, welds, and compression stops require tolerance analysis and structural substantiation.
Final RF, power, control, vent, seal, and cap hardware require exact part selection and complete populated-enclosure qualification.
Complete mass/CG, lifting, cartridge retention, cooler cantilever, cap/lid pressure, vibration/shock, transport, lid-interlock, stored-energy, and EMC/EMI substantiation remain release gates.
The IPX7 target depends on both unpowered immersion caps; accidental powered immersion with the caps removed is not covered.
